propositions: Create a standalone Git helper script that prepares an off-repository backup bundle and JSON manifest containing the old ticket tip and specified pin refs without performing any remote mutations
Enumerate live origin heads and tags at runtime using git ls-remote, collapse annotated-tag peeling lines onto canonical refs, and classify each commit ref's ancestry relationship to the old tip
Refuse execution if the clone is partial/promisor, if output paths are inside the repository/Git directory/worktrees, or if pre-existing refs/reclaim-backup/ refs exist; provide a fresh-clone remedy
Verify the completed bundle using git bundle verify and restore it into a throwaway repository to confirm the exact old-tip and pin-tip OIDs match the manifest
Ensure the helper performs no remote push, delete, or ref mutation, with origin heads/tags snapshot byte-identical before and after successful execution
Clean up only the invocation-specific helper namespace on both normal success and caught failures; abnormal termination recovery requires fresh clone rerun
